summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **No code changes made.** I read through the full chain first since this is auth-adjacent — here's what I found and what I'd propose.  ### What I found on inspection (read-only)  The ticket's working theory — "client-side wiring bug, e.g. localStorage fallback or missing watchlist_id" — **doesn't hold up**:  - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`: no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the client. Load and save both go through `api.get`/`api.post`/`api.delete` against `/watchlist*`. - `client/src/lib/api.ts`: every request
